mines.mine_notes: Gold mining complex near Timmins, Ontario (Hoyle Pond, Hollinger, Borden, Pamour, Dome mine and mill). Acquired 100% from Newmont (via Goldcorp Canada) on April 15, 2025 for $425M ($200M cash + $75M in shares + $150M deferred, 4 x $37.5M from Dec 31, 2027). Production since 1910 totals ~70 Moz. AIF does not disclose actual 2025 production, costs, or grades (fields null) — data_status partial. 2024 PEA: 22-yr mine life (Hoyle Pond 2025-2035, Borden 2025-2033, Pamour open pit 2025-2046 + stockpile reclaim 2047); M&I resources 69.7 Mt @ 1.76 g/t Au (~3,932 koz), inferred 254 Mt @ 1.53 g/t Au (~12,500 koz). No reserves declared (PEA-stage).

mines.mine_notes: Development-stage open pit silver project, Chihuahua state (100%). P&P reserves: 327 Mt @ 28.7 g/t Ag, 0.080 g/t Au, 0.41% Pb, 0.72% Zn = 302 Moz Ag, 0.84 Moz Au, 2.96 Blb Pb, 5.18 Blb Zn (eff. Feb 16, 2024; $20/oz Ag, $1,600/oz Au). FS-stage; mine plan on reserves only. No production in FY2025.
